TITLE: Unmatched Crust and Fresh Mozzarella
IMPORTANT POINTS: The Margherita pizza uses authentic San Marzano sauce and buffalo mozzarella. Crust is fermented for 48 hours giving it a light, airy Neapolitan texture with nice charring. Wood fire oven runs at 450C.

TITLE: Disappointing Vegan and Dairy-Free Options
IMPORTANT POINTS: Tried the vegan plant-based cheese pizza. The cheese substitute did not melt well and had a rubbery texture. Lack of vegetable toppings made it feel overpriced for what was offered.

TITLE: Fast Service but Loud Dining Environment
IMPORTANT POINTS: Pizzas arrived in under 12 minutes on a busy Friday night. However, acoustics inside are terrible and background music was too loud to hold a normal conversation.

TITLE: Signature Truffle Mushroom Pizza is a Must Try
IMPORTANT POINTS: Loaded with portobello mushrooms, fresh thyme, and white truffle oil. Cream base balance is spot on without making the crust soggy. Garlic dip on the side pairs perfectly.

TITLE: Overpriced Drinks and Small Dessert Portions
IMPORTANT POINTS: Craft sodas and mocktails are priced high at 8 dollars each with mostly ice. The tiramisu tasted authentic with mascarpone and espresso, but portion size was tiny for the cost.

TITLE: Great Outdoor Patio for Groups
IMPORTANT POINTS: Outdoor seating is heated, spacious, and pet friendly. Group combo deals offering two large specialty pies, salad, and garlic knots provide solid value for money.

TITLE: Gluten-Free Base Lacked Structure
IMPORTANT POINTS: Ordered the gluten-free crust for the pepperoni pie. Base was overly crumbly and broke apart immediately when picked up. Standard toppings were fresh, but cross-contamination risk wasn't clearly stated by staff.

TITLE: Best Spicy Pepperoni and Hot Honey Combo
IMPORTANT POINTS: The Diavola pie with spicy salami, chili flakes, and hot honey drizzle was phenomenal. Crust held up crisp under grease, and heat level was balanced without overpowering the sauce.

TITLE: Delivery Took Too Long and Arrived Lukewarm
IMPORTANT POINTS: Online order took 75 minutes to arrive on a Sunday evening. Crust became chewy in the cardboard box and cheese had solidified. Recommended for dine-in only, not takeaway.

TITLE: Friendly Staff and Impressive Local Beer Selection
IMPORTANT POINTS: Staff provided quick recommendations and accommodated ingredient swaps without extra charges. Extensive local craft beer tap list that pairs nicely with heavy meat toppings.

TITLE: Kid Friendly Amenities and High Chairs
IMPORTANT POINTS: Restaurant provides coloring sheets, crayons, and high chairs for toddlers. Personal mini-pizzas for kids come sliced into bite-sized portions with mild tomato sauce.

TITLE: Burrata Appetizer Was the Highlight
IMPORTANT POINTS: Creamy fresh burrata served over roasted cherry tomatoes, balsamic glaze, and warm focaccia bread. Better than the main pizzas themselves.

TITLE: Cleanliness Needs Improvement in Restrooms
IMPORTANT POINTS: Kitchen area was clean and visible from the dining room, but customer restrooms lacked soap and paper towels during peak hours. Service was otherwise average.

TITLE: Solid Lunch Special Deal
IMPORTANT POINTS: Offers a lunch special from 11 AM to 3 PM: personal two-topping pizza, side Caesar salad, and fountain drink for 12 dollars. Fast prep time makes it ideal for quick office breaks.

TITLE: Underwhelming Dessert Pizza
IMPORTANT POINTS: Nutella and banana dessert pizza had dough that was undercooked in the center and overly sweet. Stick to the savory pizzas instead.
